results.name: 3-4 Sit-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
Place your hands behind your head, keeping your elbows wide.
Engage your core and lift your upper body towards your knees, coming up about three-quarters of the way.
Slowly lower your upper body back to the starting position and repeat.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to avoid straining your lower back.
Avoid pulling on your neck with your hands; use your abdominal muscles to lift your upper body.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift and inhaling as you lower.
results.description: 3-4 Sit-Up is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Obliques.

results.name: 45 Degree Bicycle Twisting Crunch
instructions: Align yourself to 45 degrees to the floor by fixing your left foot into the footrest and supporting your thigh against the padded platform.
Place your left hand behind your head and your right hand on your waist.
Straighten your upper leg wide and bend your knee while twisting your torso and bringing the opposite elbow towards it.
Return to the initial position, and repeat.
tips: Ensure your feet are securely positioned on the hyperextension bench to maintain stability throughout the exercise.
Focus on engaging your core muscles to lift and twist, avoiding pulling on your neck with your hands.
Perform the exercise with controlled movements to maximize muscle engagement and reduce the risk of strain.
results.description: 45 Degree Bicycle Twisting Crunch is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Quadriceps.

results.name: 45 Degree Bicycle Twisting
instructions: Align yourself to 45 degrees to the floor by fixing your left foot into the footrest and supporting your thigh against the padded platform.
Place your left hand behind your head and your right hand on your waist.
Open your upper leg slightly and bend your knee while bringing your opposite elbow towards it.
Return to the initial position, and repeat.
tips: Keep your hips pressed on the hyperextension bench to engage your core muscles more effectively and protect your spine.
Avoid pulling on your neck with your hand; use your core to lift and twist, keeping your neck in a neutral position.
Perform the exercise slowly and deliberately to maximize muscle engagement and reduce the risk of strain.
results.description: 45 Degree Bicycle Twisting is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Quadriceps.

results.name: 45 Degree Side Bend
instructions: Place your feet one after the other onto the footrests and support your thigh against the platform.
Place your hands behind your head and assume an upright position with a straight back.
Crunch your torso toward the platform and then to the other side.
Repeat while keeping yourself stable.
tips: Maintain a steady and controlled pace to ensure proper form and prevent strain.
Focus on using your oblique muscles to lift your upper body, avoiding any jerking or sudden movements.
Keep your neck in a neutral position to avoid straining it during the exercise.
results.description: 45 Degree Side Bend is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Lower Back.

results.name: 45 Degree Twisting Hyperextension
instructions: Fix your feet to the footrests and press your thighs against the padded platform.
Place your hands behind your head and lean forward.
Raise yourself by leaning backward and twisting your torso to a side.
Hold for a while, return to the initial position, and repeat.
tips: Perform the twisting motion smoothly and avoid jerking to prevent strain on your back.
Engage your core muscles throughout the exercise to maintain stability and support your spine.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift and twist, and inhaling as you lower back down.
results.description: 45 Degree Twisting Hyperextension is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the spine (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Glutes.

results.name: 90 Degree Heel Touch
instructions: Lie down on your back with your hips and knees bent to 90 degrees and your arms extended overhead.
Raise your upper back and bring your arms forward to touch your heels.
Hold for a while, return to the initial position, and repeat.
tips: Keep your neck relaxed and avoid straining it by using your core muscles to lift your shoulders.
Ensure your lower back stays pressed into the mat to engage your core effectively and protect your spine.
Perform the exercise with controlled movements to maximize muscle engagement and reduce the risk of injury.
results.description: 90 Degree Heel Touch is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

results.name: Ab Mat Sit-Up
instructions: Sit on the floor with a yoga mat placed under your lower back, knees bent facing outwards, and feet on the floor touching together. Hands behind your head.
Lean back to lie down, keeping your arms behind your head.
Use your core muscles to sit your torso up, return to the starting position and repeat.
tips: Engage your core muscles throughout the movement to maximize effectiveness and protect your lower back.
Avoid using momentum by performing the movement slowly and with control.
Keep your feet on the floor and your knees stable to maintain proper form.
results.description: Ab Mat Sit-Up is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

results.name: Ab Tuck
instructions: Start by hanging on a dip station, holding the parallel bars with your arms extended and your body straight.
Lift your knees towards your chest while lightly extending your hips backward, engaging your core muscles.
Extend your legs back downwards to starting position.
Repeat the movement.
tips: Engage your core muscles throughout the exercise to maintain control and stability.
Perform the movement slowly and deliberately to avoid using momentum and maximize muscle engagement.
Keep your upper body stable and avoid swinging to ensure proper form.
results.description: Ab Tuck is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

results.name: Ab Wheel All the Way Out
instructions: Start by kneeling on a mat with the ab wheel placed on the floor in front of you, holding it with both hands. Ensure your arms are extended and your back is straight.
Roll the ab wheel forward, extending your body into a straight line while keeping your core engaged and your hips slightly extended backward.
Roll the ab wheel back to the starting position, using your core muscles to control the movement and maintain stability.
Repeat the movement, extending fully and returning to the starting position each time.
tips: Keep your core muscles engaged throughout the exercise to protect your lower back and maintain stability.
Perform the movement slowly and with control, avoiding using momentum to maximize muscle engagement.
Ensure your hips are slightly extended backward when rolling out to maintain proper form and prevent lower back strain.
results.description: Ab Wheel All the Way Out is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a wheel roller, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Shoulders.

results.name: Ab Wheel Halfway Out
instructions: Start by kneeling on a mat with the ab wheel placed on the floor in front of you, holding it with both hands. Ensure your arms are extended and your back is straight.
Roll the ab wheel forward, extending your body halfway while keeping your core engaged and your hips slightly extended backward.
Roll the ab wheel back to the starting position, using your core muscles to control the movement and maintain stability.
Repeat the movement, extending halfway and returning to the starting position each time.
tips: Keep your core muscles engaged throughout the exercise to protect your lower back and maintain stability.
Perform the movement slowly and with control, avoiding using momentum to maximize muscle engagement.
Ensure your hips are slightly extended backward when rolling out to maintain proper form and prevent lower back strain.
results.description: Ab Wheel Halfway Out is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a wheel roller, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Shoulders.
